name: C&C: Shockwave
description: A large fan-made overhaul of Zero Hour with new units, generals and balance (ModDB Editor's Choice 2008).
notes: On the download page choose the full release. A .zip or "no installer" download installs automatically. If only the .exe installer is offered, see the README section on mods that come as an .exe.

name: C&C: Shockwave Chaos
description: A deliberately over-the-top add-on for Shockwave with lots of new and reworked units, generals and abilities.
notes: An add-on: C&C: Shockwave must be installed first. On the download page choose the latest full version. Rallypoint combines it with Shockwave when you launch, so nothing in your Shockwave folder is changed.
